title: Crusader Paintball
specs: Gellet Ball for ages 6 and up, lowest impact paintball option
Low Impact 50 Cal Paintball for ages 10 and up, less intense than traditional paintball
Field paint only, fresh and field protected
Players must be 8 years old to play low impact paintball and 10 years old for traditional paintball
Proper eye protection designed for paintball is mandatory on the playing fields and walkways
Players must have barrel bag/cover (no plugs allowed) and ASTM compliant mask for own gear entry
Semi-automatic markers capped at 10 bps and 285 fps max
Waiver required for all players; under 18 must have parent or guardian sign
Private parties require minimum 10 players and 4 day notice
Corporate outings available with 2 hours private field play

options.detail: Entry from 10am until 4pm for players with their own gear. Must have barrel bag/cover, ASTM compliant mask, and tank in Hydro.

options.name: Gellet Ball

options.detail: 3 Hours of Private Play (about 10-15 games), Covered Picnic Pavilion available for extra time

blurb: Guests play paintball on private or public fields using rental or personal equipment. Options include traditional paintball, low impact 50-cal paintball, and gellet ball for younger players. Private parties and corporate outings are available with various time packages and equipment included.
extraNote: Private parties require 10 person minimum, 4 day notice, and 50% non-refundable deposit · No refunds on paint sales or rental fees; returns accepted within 30 days unopened for store credit · No outside paintballs allowed; use field paint only · No alcohol or drugs allowed on premises · Cancellation and deposit policies for private parties detailed with 50% non-refundable deposit
